damages are widely acknowledged as the customary measure of relief for

most commonly recognized 
damage measures are reliance, restitution, and disgorgement. 
Reliance damages 
are based on a promisee's reliance 
interests, 
which are subverted when he has changed his position to his detriment 
by relying on the promise. The promisee may, for example, have incurred 
expenses in preparing to perform his part of the deal. Reliance damages 
would reimburse those expenses among other losses "caused by reliance."
